annotations.text: OQ-1 — "Mine" toggle: v1 uses the existing filter_created_by_me flag. Last-updated-by is not in the list payload yet.
OQ-2 — Column vocabulary: Editing / Pending review / Submitted / Approved (QAed, status 2) / Discontinued. Confirm whether the bilateral 'Approved' row is the same state.
No drag-and-drop. Cards are buttons. Status moves only from inside the result or from QA (TRD W1).
Viewport-locked like the Reporting tab: the board scrolls inside the app frame, the body never scrolls sideways. Closed group collapsed by default (volatile).
